name: Valencian-Inspired Paella
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 500 g (1 pound) boneless, skinless chicken, diced
1 large whole rabbit (or additional pound of chicken breast as a substitute)
3 large red bell peppers, one cut into strips and the remaining diced
500 g (1 pound) diced or grated tomatoes
500 g (1 pound) canned cannellini beans in water, thoroughly rinsed
8–10 threads of saffron and/or 1.5 tsp yellow food coloring
3 cups short-grain white rice (also called Valencian rice or pearl rice)

steps: Please read paella cooking techniques before attempting this recipe.

culture.text: This is not a traditional Spanish paella recipe, however it is inspired by paella valenciana because it includes chicken, rabbit, duck and beans (the major ingredients of that dish). This recipe is not for the faint of heart. It requires a significant amount of work. However, the creamy duck flavor of this dish is well worth the effort if you have the time.
